name: calendar
summary: Month, week and resource calendar for two related Grit resources
description: Adds a /calendar screen to the admin using CalendarKit Pro. One generated resource supplies the events (a datetime field), and a second one supplies the rows (rooms, people, equipment) through a relationship field. Click an event to open its record, drag it to another row to change the relationship, and drag it in time to change the date.
nextSteps: On a triple Next.js project: pnpm install
Open /calendar. If the auto-detected mapping is wrong, edit the config block at the top of apps/admin/app/(dashboard)/calendar/page.tsx
The event resource needs a datetime field and a relationship-select to the row resource. Other architectures get no files from this version.
